reviews.review_title: Review at Pandan Leaf Saigon Restaurant & Rooftop Bar
reviews.review_text:
Zac Gray
New Zealand19 contributions
3
Masterclass in Hospitality and quality food!
Oct 2026 • Couples
After reading a few glowing reviews on this restaurant my wife and i decided to check it out. 
I am so glad we did!

My wife made a reservation last minute and we were able to get a seat on the rooftop balcony. What a stunning view!

We were warmly welcomed and seated by the most attentive and beautiful host Jimmy. His dedication to providing us with the warmest experience has not been matched in my 20 years of dining out throughout the world. The dishes he recommended us hit the spot perfectly. We had the grilled buffalo, the special pancakes and also the pork paste and lemongrass.

To top the experience off Jimmy told us exactly how they made their dipping sauce for the pancakes and even shifted our table to get the best view of the city, along with taking photos of my wife and i with the fantastic city skyline view in the background.

Pandan Leaf Saigon, 10/10 experience led by a masterclass in service and hospitality Jimmy. I even had to get a photo with this legend!

This was my first time dining at this restaurant, and overall, it was a very enjoyable experience. The menu is quite varied, featuring a nice balance between traditional Vietnamese dishes and a few Western selections. I tried three different items — each was beautifully plated, flavorful, and had its own unique character.
The service was another highlight. Staff were attentive and welcoming throughout the evening. I especially appreciated the assistance of a manager named Bino, who was extremely helpful in answering my questions about the dishes and made me feel well taken care of.
One thing to keep in mind: the restaurant can get quite crowded during dinner hours, so there may be a short wait. Also, the outdoor seating area, which I really liked, is not usable during rainy weather.

Had high hopes, but the food did not deliver
Mar 2025 • Couples
I don’t understand the great reviews. The staff was very nice and the place was cute, but that’s it. The food was at best mediocre. We had two mango smoothies, made with raw mangoes, so they were a bit bitter and flavorless. One dish (duck with mushrooms) was so salty it was hard to eat and the meat was overcooked. There was a lot of meat though, so that was nice. The other dish, pork with pandan rice was a bit bland and the meat was tough and mostly fat. The meat did have a few nice grilled bits. I really wanted to like this place, but couldn’t. I’m sure in the evening, the ambience is great, so perhaps nicer then.

First lunch in Ho Chi Minh City - First lunch in Ho Chi Minh City
Oct 2024 • Couples
This restaurant, quite central, is very colorful and cheerful, clean and more "westernized" than the previous ones. When we arrived, it was already full of tourists. The restaurant develops in height. We ate well, but the atmosphere was less authentic and the taste of the dishes markedly different, compared to the north and center of Vietnam. In big cities, everything loses its magic a little, unfortunately. However, nothing negative to say about the dishes and staff, very kind and considerate as always. Even more cheeky, especially with English;) 
P.S. The crème caramel is fantastic!

“A Hidden Gem in the Heart of the City”
Jul 2024 • Business
From the moment you step into this cozy Vietnamese haven, you're greeted with the warmest of welcomes, a sign of the exceptional service that awaits. The ambiance strikes a perfect balance between traditional charm and modern comfort, making it an ideal spot for both casual lunches and intimate dinners.

The menu is a delightful journey through the flavors of Vietnam, with each dish boasting fresh ingredients and vibrant herbs that dance on the palate. The Phở is a standout, with its rich, aromatic broth and perfectly cooked noodles, while the **Bánh Mì** offers a symphony of textures and tastes that are nothing short of addictive.

But it's not just the food that makes this place special; it's the people. The staff goes above and beyond to ensure your experience is nothing less than perfect, offering recommendations with a smile and attending to your every need with genuine care.

In a city brimming with dining options, this Vietnamese restaurant is a treasure that stands out for its dedication to quality, authenticity, and hospitality. It's a culinary experience that leaves you yearning for more, and a reminder of how beautiful simple, well-crafted food can be.
